reason: Pensioners paid in all their lives. Fund care from general tax, not by shaving what old people live on.
Get the carers sorted first. Same faces each day matters more to me than arguing over pensions.
I am 86 and I rely on my pension. Leave it alone. Tax everyone fairly for care.
Pensions rise faster than wages already. A floor for the poorest and a change for the rest seems fair.
I have a good pension but care is a national duty. Spread the cost wider than pensioners.
Do the local bit now, it is proven. Money fights can wait until we see it working.
Pensioners like me have little slack. Cutting the lock to fund care feels like robbing one old person for another.
I have cared for family. Familiar carers matter now. Pay can be sorted while it starts.
Care must be free. Changing the lock with protection for the poor is a fair price for it.
I am sick and on benefits. Leave pensions. The rich can pay more tax for care.
Try neighbourhood care first and see the saving. Then decide who pays, not the other way round.
Don't touch pensions. People planned around them. Find the money elsewhere.
